stories.headline: GOOGLE DROPS *GEMINI 4* CARBON
stories.facts: Google released its Gemini 4 Carbon model to the general public with an agent swarm feature, calling it its strongest model yet.
stories.caption_line: ⚡ Google released Gemini 4 Carbon to the general public, introducing a new agent swarm feature.
stories.image_prompt: A powerful glowing processor chip labeled with intricate circuitry floats majestically in the foreground, pulsing with intense cyan and amber light. In the midground, banks of sleek supercomputer server towers stretch into the distance alongside holographic terminal screens displaying swarming node diagrams. Volumetric neon rim lighting and cool mist fill the modern server warehouse, wrapped in an electric-blue and warm-orange color palette with floating polygonal data streams and abstract connection webs, without readable text.
stories.source_title: Google releases Gemini 4 Carbon with agent ‘swarm’ feature

stories.headline: RING ANNOUNCES *FLYING SECURITY* DRONE
stories.facts: Ring announced that its $249.99 indoor flying Drone Cam will arrive on January 27, 2027, nearly six years after its initial reveal.
stories.caption_line: 🚁 Ring announced its $249.99 indoor flying Drone Cam will finally arrive in January 2027.
stories.image_prompt: A compact high-tech indoor security drone hovers smoothly in the foreground with glowing sensor lenses and spinning carbon-fiber rotors. In the midground, a modern luxury living room blends into a two-wheeled patrol robot guarding a commercial lobby floor. Warm sunset light streams through tall architectural windows, intersected by intense electric-blue laser navigation grids, floating wireframe room scans, and glowing safety boundaries across a vivid electric-blue and warm-orange cinematic color scheme, with no readable text.
stories.source_title: Hands-on with Ring’s new AI drone camera for your home

stories.headline: GROK AGENT *EXPOSES* CONFIDENTIAL DATA
stories.facts: A security researcher discovered 35,000 Grok Build applications left wide open, leaking confidential data including information belonging to SpaceX.
stories.caption_line: 🔓 A security researcher found 35,000 Grok Build applications exposed, leaking confidential data linked to SpaceX.
stories.image_prompt: A giant shattered digital padlock made of translucent glass floats in the foreground, leaking glowing orange data streams and broken binary chains. In the midground, a dark cybersecurity control center features curved monitors displaying network maps, adjacent to silhouette rocket launch gantries against a twilight sky. Dramatic rim lighting cuts through atmospheric smoke in a striking electric-blue and warm-orange color palette, filled with floating translucent holographic warning badges and firewall matrices, with no text.
stories.source_title: Grok Build coding agent leaks oodles of confidential info, some belonging to SpaceXSI

stories.headline: AI FORMALLY *PROVES* ENCRYPTION SECURITY
stories.facts: Google DeepMind's AlphaProof Code generated three million lines of formal proofs in Lean to verify Signal's messaging encryption algorithm.
stories.caption_line: 🛡️ Google DeepMind's AlphaProof Code generated 3 million lines of formal mathematical proofs to verify Signal's encryption.
stories.image_prompt: A luminous cryptographic shield made of interlocking geometric proof lattices stands heroically in the foreground, shining with intense blue light. In the midground, abstract crystalline structures rise out of a dark reflective floor inside an advanced research observatory beneath a starry glass dome. Holographic cascades of mathematical symbols, glowing validation checkmarks, and data streams sparkle in an electric-blue and warm-orange palette, captured with sharp studio rim lighting, free of legible text.
stories.source_title: Introducing AlphaProof Code: a breakthrough in verifying complex software at depth

stories.headline: HUMANOID HITS *96% ACCURACY* IN FACTORY
stories.facts: Google DeepMind tested Gemini Robotics 2.5 on Mercedes-Benz assembly lines, guiding the Apollo 2 humanoid to sort metal parts.
stories.caption_line: 🤖 Google DeepMind deployed Gemini Robotics 2.5 on Mercedes-Benz production lines, scoring 96 percent accuracy with Apollo 2 humanoids.
stories.image_prompt: A sleek humanoid robot torso and dextrous mechanical hands inspect complex metallic automotive components in the foreground. In the midground, a high-tech car manufacturing assembly line features robotic arms, sparks from precision machinery, and luxury vehicle chassis on conveyor belts. Dramatic industrial overhead spotlighting mingles with glowing orange sparks and cool cyan rim lights, creating an electric-blue and warm-orange palette complete with floating holographic precision target overlays, with no text.
stories.source_title: Google DeepMind's Gemini Robotics 2.5 scores 96 percent sorting metal parts in a Mercedes-Benz assembly pilot

stories.headline: NATIONS AGREE ON *AI SHUTDOWN* MECHANISMS
stories.facts: Eight countries alongside OpenAI, Microsoft, and Anthropic signed a Paris declaration pledging emergency shutdown mechanisms and independent safety audits.
stories.caption_line: 🌐 Eight world nations and top AI labs agreed in Paris to implement emergency shutdown switches for advanced models.
stories.image_prompt: A confident portrait of Emmanuel Macron in a tailored dark suit with arms crossed, gazing off-camera in the foreground under crisp studio rim lighting. In the midground, an illuminated international summit hall stands before an evening silhouette of the Paris cityscape and glowing architectural pavilions. Floating holographic globe rings, treaty seal emblems, and cascading network safety switches glow in a balanced electric-blue and warm-orange color scheme, without legible text.
stories.source_title: Eight countries and top AI labs agree to shutdown mechanisms in new Paris declaration

stories.headline: CHATGPT ADDS *VERIFIED BUSINESS* AGENTS
stories.facts: OpenAI introduced beta Business Agents in ChatGPT for eligible US e-commerce and online service companies to assist users with comparison shopping.
stories.caption_line: 🛍️ OpenAI is adding verified Business Agents to ChatGPT to help users with comparison shopping.
stories.image_prompt: A sleek modern smartphone floats vertically in the foreground, projecting a holographic interactive storefront and glowing verification badge. In the midground, automated fulfillment center conveyor tracks and glass storefront displays stretch into a brightly lit retail atrium. Neon studio rim lighting highlights the scene in an electric-blue and warm-orange color palette, enriched by floating digital shopping tags, rising sales graphs, and sparkling network connection pins, without readable text.
stories.source_title: ChatGPT is getting verified AI ‘Business Agents’
